That's the only time my kids will leave me alone...|Kass|BotW}} * [[Amali]] {{Small|(mother)}} * [[Notts]] {{Small|(eldest sister)}}{{Cite|Kheel, youngest of the five sisters inhabiting Rito Village, is furious that her sisters haven't shown up for singing practice.

Go and find her eldest-sister, Notts, second-eldest sister, Kotts, third-eldest sister, Genli, and fourth eldest-sister, Cree {{Color BotW|Red|somewhere in Rito Village}}, and tell them to meet Kheel.|Adventure Log|BotW}} * [[Kotts]] {{Small|(second-eldest sister)}} * [[Cree]] {{Small|(second-youngest sister)}} * [[Kheel]] {{Small|(youngest sister)}} }} |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Genli||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Genli|Game Screen|BotW}}{{Cite|Genli|Game Screen|TotK}} ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Genli is a [[Rito]] child who lives in [[Rito Village]]. She can initially be found in the Village's [[Kitchen (Location)|Kitchen]], where she asks who [[Link]] is and if he has come to stop [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]].{{Cite|Who are you? Some kind of traveler? Did you come to make that big bird up in the sky stop bothering us?|Genli|BotW}} Genli is upset if Link confirms he has, as [[Kheel]] will make her go to singing practice if everything returns to normal.{{Cite|[Sure did!] {{Big|Nooo!}} If everything goes back to normal, Kheel will make me go to singing practice.|Genli|BotW}} She feels bad that [[Molli]]'s father, [[Harth]] got hurt, but she does not want to practice.{{Cite|{{Small|I mean...I feel bad that Molli's dad, Mr. Harth, got hurt, but...}} But I definitely know I don't want to practice singing!|Genli|BotW}} According to [[Amali]], Genli and her sisters have become needier since Divine Beast Vah Medoh started flying around. After the "[[Divine Beast Vah Medoh (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Medoh]]" [[Main Quest]] has been completed, Link can find Kheel at [[Warbler's Nest]]. She is angry that Genli and the rest of her sisters have not arrived for their rehearsal.{{Cite|{{Big|Grrrrrr! My sisters are dumb DUMMIES!}} They promised we'd rehearse together, but NO ONE showed up!|Kheel|BotW}} They are supposed to perform for [[Kaneli]], the elder of Rito Village, but Kheel thinks are not prepared to do so.{{Cite|We have to perform our song for the {{Color BotW|Blue|elder}} at {{Color BotW|Red|Warbler's Nest}}! We're going to be laughed off the stage...|Kheel|BotW}} Since Link is a scary [[Hylian]], Kheel asks him to find her sisters and remind them of rehearsal.{{Cite|Hey, you... You look like I can use you... Thaaaat is to say...you look like a nice guy who likes to help people in need. Can you go tell my sisters in Rito Village to stop ditching rehearsal? They won't listen to me, but they might listen to a scary-looking Hylian like you.|Kheel|BotW}} However, she thinks Genli will be difficult, as she is probably in the Kitchen demanding [[Salmon Meunière]].{{Cite|Although Genli might be a tough sell. She's probably in the {{Color BotW|Red|kitchen}} yelling, {{Big|"I want some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}!"}} ...or something like that.|Kheel|BotW}} This begins the "[[Recital at Warbler's Nest]]" [[Shrine Quest]]. Back in Rito Village, Genli can be found in the Kitchen, where she is begging for Salmon Meunière.{{Cite|Hurry! Hurry! {{Big|I NEED {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} in my belly!}}|Genli|BotW}} She refuses to practice with Kheel until she gets it.{{Cite|I know {{Color BotW|Blue|Kheel}} wants me to practice singing with her, but I just can't. Not until I get my {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}!|Genli|BotW}} The rest of her sisters have already left to gather ingredients for her, though she did not expect them to listen to her.{{Cite|My sisters already left to get {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} ingredients. I told them I wouldn't sing until I get it. I didn't expect them to actually make it for me, though!|Genli|BotW}} Genli does not want to practice her singing, but she still does want Salmon Meunière.{{Cite|I don't want to practice singing... {{Small|but I really do want some yummy {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}.}}|Genli|BotW}} She wonders what is taking them so long, as they were only supposed to go to [[The Slippery Falcon]].{{Cite|What is taking my sisters to long? I thought they were just going to the {{Color BotW|Red|Slippery Falcon}}.|Genli|BotW}} When Link speaks to [[Notts]], [[Kotts]], and [[Cree]], they will each give him one ingredient on the condition he makes Salmon Meunière for Genli.{{Cite|Well then...I guess I'll give the {{Color BotW|Blue|Tabantha wheat}} to you! Please make the best {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli!|Notts|BotW}}{{Cite|Please take this {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}} and go make some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli.|Kotts|BotW}}{{Cite|If I give you this {{Color BotW|Blue|goat butter}}, will you make some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}} for Genli? She should be in the {{Color BotW|Red|kitchen}}.|Cree|BotW}} In the Kitchen, Genli can smell Salmon Meunière if Link has it on him.{{Cite|*sniff sniff...*
*sniff sniff sniff*
That amazing smell... Could it be?
{{Big|Sa...
Sa...
{{Color BotW|Blue|Salmon meunière}}?!}}|Genli|BotW}} She frantically asks Link to let her have it.{{Cite|You're going to let me have some, right? RIGHT?!|Genli|BotW}} She is very excited when Link allows her to have some, and she eats it immediately.{{Cite|[Enjoy!] YAAAAAAAAAAAAY! ♪Time to dig in!♪ *munch munch*...
Hngh mngh...
Hnff! Hurk! Mmmmmm... I'm stuffed!|Genli|BotW}} Reminded of her promise to her sisters, Genli realizes she should uphold her word.{{Cite|...Huh? My promise to my sisters? I suppose I shouldn't break my promise...|Genli|BotW}} While she enjoys singing, she gets nervous doing so in front of others.{{Cite|I really DO like singing!
...But I am too nervous to sing in front of other people.|Genli|BotW}} She thinks that her stage fright might be cured if she practices with her sisters.{{Cite|I have SERIOUS stage fright...but maybe practicing with my sisters will help me feel more comfortable.|Genli|BotW}} Genli thanks Link for the Salmon Meunière, claiming it was soft, flaky, and delicious.{{Cite|Anyway, thank you for the amazing {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}! It was so soft and flaky and delicious!|Genli|BotW}} Deciding to give the rehearsal her all, she asks Link to come visit.{{Cite|I'll give this rehearsal my all. ♪Come listen later!♪|Genli|BotW}} At Warbler's Nest, Genli is found happily singing with the rest of her sisters.{{Cite|♪La loo loo loo laaaaaaa!♪|Genli|BotW}} All the singing she is doing is making her hungry, and she asks Link if he wants to hear her stomach's song or a song about Warbler's Nest.{{Cite| Phew... All this singing is making me hungry.Which would you rather hear? My tummy's song or a song about Warbler's Nest?|Genli|BotW}} When Link asks to hear the Warbler's Nest song, the sisters will recite the song together. Once [[Voo Lota Shrine]] rises from the ground, Genli will remark that it is cool that Warbler's Nest had such a secret.{{Cite|So cool! Who knew Warbler's Nest was keeping a secret like that|Genli|BotW}} The sisters decide to leave to inform their mother,{{Cite|Let's tell mom!|Notts|BotW}} and the five of them race back to Rito Village. Afterwards, Genli practices singing with her sisters near [[Akh Va'quot Shrine]].{{Cite|On my way to go practice at the village shrine!|Genli|BotW}} She shows off her singing to Link,{{Cite|Hey, check it out. I'm practicing my singing!|Genli|BotW}} admitting that she never would have realized how much she likes to sing if Link had not helped Kheel.{{Cite|You know, if you didn't go to Kheel, I never would have realized how much I actually like to sing.|Genli|BotW}} Now, she is having fun with her sisters.{{Cite|Buy thanks to you, I'm having a blast!|Genli|BotW}} After Link has completed all of the [[Ancient Shrine]]s, Genli notices that he looks cooler.{{Cite|Wow...you look different somehow...Cooler... WHOA! You found all the of the shrines!|Genli|BotW}} She congratulates him and calls him a good boy.{{Cite|CONGRATULATIONS! GOOD BOY! OK. Hope you liked the congratulations!|Genli|BotW}} If Link speaks to her again, she notes he looks like he is hungry.{{Cite|What's wrong? You kind of look like you're hungry?|Genli|BotW}} Once [[Kass]] has returned to Rito Village, Genli and her sisters spend all time singing with him. On her way home at the end of the day, Genli reveals that Kaneli likes the way she sings.{{Cite|The elder said he likes the way I sing!|Genli|BotW}} She decides to eat some Salmon Meunière, as she can practice more tomorrow.{{Cite|I'm gonna go eat some {{Color BotW|Blue|salmon meunière}}. I can practice more tomorrow!|Genli|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Amali * Cree * Kass * Kheel * Kotts * Notts * Recital at Warbler's Nest * Rito * Rito Village }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Hyruleans, Rito, Rito Villagers |characters= BotW, TotK }}
